_note: Self-check questions built only from the prakriti passage of Caraka Samhita Vimanasthana 8.95-100 (Trikamji numbering, as in the SARIT TEI edition), with one option from Ashtanga Hridaya Sharirasthana 3.101 where Caraka is silent. Every option names the verse it comes from. A dosha the text says nothing about on a dimension gets no option there; 'neither' scores nothing. Traits the text states only as outcomes (lifespan, wealth, offspring, liability to disorder) are deliberately not asked.

vata.name: Vata
vata.summary: The text derives each vata trait from vata's qualities: dry, light, unsteady, abundant, swift, cool, rough and clear. People of this type are described as slight and dry-skinned, light sleepers who talk a lot, move quickly and restlessly, take things in fast but retain them less well, feel the cold, and have joints that crack.

pitta.name: Pitta
pitta.summary: The text derives each pitta trait from pitta's qualities: hot, sharp, liquid, sour and pungent. People of this type are described as delicate, with many moles or freckles, strong hunger and thirst, heat intolerance, copious sweat and strong body odour, fine light hair that greys early, loose joints, and a bold, quick temper.

kapha.name: Kapha
kapha.summary: The text derives each kapha trait from kapha's qualities: unctuous, smooth, soft, firm, dense, slow, steady, heavy, cool and clear. People of this type are described as solidly built, with smooth glossy skin, mild hunger and thirst, little sweat, a slow, steady tread and speech, firm joints, a pleasant voice, and a calm temperament with plenty of strength.
